Name: CP-RSVObelisk recolor mach MutedFairyBuildings

Description:
一个CP模组，季节性美化里奇赛德村传送晶塔。本模组推荐搭配[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23071]IdaIda's Fairy seasonal Buildings (for CP and AT) at Stardew Valley Nexus - Mods and community[/url]使用。
A CP mod retextured the sprites of the RSVObelisk mach [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23071]IdaIda's Fairy seasonal Buildings (for CP and AT) at Stardew Valley Nexus - Mods and community[/url].Change with the seasons。
-Installation-
1.Install the latest version of Content Patcher
2.Install the latest version of Ridgeside Village mod.
3.Unzip the mod folder into Mods.
